title: bulk actions: a promoted action's field-backed param (`field` + `objectOverride`) renders a raw text box on the selection bar, and the confirm step lists raw ids
body:
Filing gate ①: a product defect measured at a public door (finding A-10). Filed by the triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`), splitting objectstack-ai/objectstack#22722 (the maintainer's HotCRM browser pass, objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2058, measured on `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Read on objectui `main` `ce991bd70f`

- `packages/plugin-grid/src/resolveBulkActions.ts`, `toBulkParam()` (about `:92`–`:106`):
  - it maps `field` onto `name` and defaults `type` to `'text'`;
  - it fills `object` from `reference`, but never resolves `field` + `objectOverride` against the object's field definitions.
- So `bulkParamToField()` builds a text widget, and `BulkActionDialog.tsx` `ParamField` renders `<input id="bulk-param-…" type="text">`.
- The confirm step resolves id → label only for lookup-ish params that carry an `object`.
- The single-record path is right because it runs `app-shell/src/utils/resolveActionParams.ts` (`param.objectOverride ?? ctx.objectName`). The bulk path never calls it.
- Both the spec guidance (`BulkActionParamSchema`, `packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts`) and `BulkActionDialog.tsx` record this as an open gap.

Measured on HotCRM: `Add to Campaign` with a `crm_campaign` param.

## Done when
- A promoted action's params resolve through the same field-backed resolution as the single-record path. One resolver, shared: it moves out of `app-shell` or is injected into `plugin-grid`. ⛔ No second copy.
- A lookup param renders the record picker on the selection bar, and the confirm step shows labels.
- Pins:
  - a field-backed lookup param on the bulk path;
  - CONTROL: a literal-typed param is unchanged.
- The spec guidance sentence that names the gap is corrected in the objectstack PR that next touches `bulk-action.zod.ts`. Name it in this PR's body.

`domain:ui` · p2.
